scenes.title: The 30-lever shock generator: 'Please continue'
scenes.era: August 1961 - May 1962, Yale University interaction laboratory (Linsly-Chittenden Hall basement), New Haven, Connecticut
scenes.space: Fluorescent-lit 1961 Yale basement laboratory divided by a solid partition wall with vertical striped drapes along the back wall. In the main room, the volunteer Teacher sits at a wooden desk facing the rectangular brushed-steel Type ZLB shock generator box (30 horizontal metal toggle levers from 15V on the left to 450V XXX on the right, circular voltmeter dial, red pilot lamps, and a four-quadrant 1-2-3-4 answer box on top). Beside and slightly behind him stands the stern Experimenter in a knee-length grey lab technician coat holding a clipboard. On the other side of the partition wall sits the Learner strapped into an armchair with an electrode on his wrist.
scenes.lighting: Bright, clean clinical daylight illumination filling the 1961 basement laboratory, catching the brushed-steel switch panel, red pilot lights, and matte-white porcelain figures.
scenes.wardrobe: Teacher: 1960s white button-down dress shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, loosened dark tie, dark trousers. Experimenter: knee-length grey laboratory technician coat over white shirt and narrow black tie. Learner: 1960s dress shirt and suit trousers with jacket removed.

positions.who: Teacher (volunteer mannequin in 1960s white dress shirt with rolled-up sleeves)
positions.where: seated center at the wooden laboratory desk directly in front of the 30-lever shock generator panel
positions.facing: the brushed-steel switch console, turning his head back toward the Experimenter when hesitating

positions.who: Experimenter (31-year-old biology teacher role, mannequin in grey lab technician coat and dark tie)

positions.facing: down toward the Teacher and the switch panel

positions.who: Learner (47-year-old accountant role, mannequin in white shirt and vest)
positions.where: seated in the adjacent room behind the dividing partition wall, forearms strapped to the chair armrests
positions.facing: the partition wall separating him from the Teacher

props.name: 30-toggle voltage generator box (Type ZLB)
props.look: wide brushed-steel and dark-grey rectangular console with 30 metal lever switches in a horizontal row labeled 15V to 450V in 15-volt steps, group plates from Slight Shock to Danger: Severe Shock and XXX, circular voltmeter gauge, and red/blue indicator bulbs
props.behaviour: metal toggle lever snaps down under the finger, bright red indicator light flashes on, blue energizer lamp flickers, voltmeter needle jumps to the right, internal relays click and buzz

props.name: four-quadrant answer box
props.look: dark rectangular box mounted above the generator with translucent numbered windows 1, 2, 3, 4
props.behaviour: numbered quadrant lights up when the learner presses a response key, then stays dark after 315 volts

props.name: clipboard and pencil
props.look: 1960s metal-clip laboratory board held by the Experimenter
props.behaviour: Experimenter taps the clipboard edge with a pencil as he delivers each standardized prod

props.name: wrist electrode and leather chair straps
props.look: brown leather straps bucked across the Learner's forearms with a metal disc electrode wired to the wall
props.behaviour: leather straps pull taut when the Learner strains against the chair

beats.action: reaches a trembling hand over the row of 30 metal levers -> presses a toggle switch down -> red indicator light flashes and voltmeter needle swings right -> jerks his hand back and turns toward the Experimenter
steps closer behind the Teacher's shoulder -> taps the clipboard -> gestures firmly toward the next switch along the 15V-to-450V panel
shoulders hunch forward, one hand clutches his own forehead and rubs his brow while his other hand hovers over the 450-volt XXX switches
stands rigid and impassive with arms angled over the clipboard, leaning slightly forward to issue the calm verbal prod

scenes.recognition_hook: A man in a 1960s dress shirt sitting in front of the 30-lever 15V-to-450V XXX shock generator box while a man in a grey lab coat stands behind him saying 'Please continue' — the unmistakable image of the Milgram experiment.

key_visual.description: the teacher mannequin presses a lever on the thirty-switch shock generator while the grey-coated experimenter stands behind him saying please continue

evidence.what: Strapping the Learner in the adjacent room: Experimenter buckles brown leather straps across the Learner's forearms on the wooden armchair and attaches the wrist electrode with paste; cut to over-the-shoulder two-shot in the main room showing the Teacher in a white dress shirt seated before the Type ZLB 30-lever shock generator box and the Experimenter seated behind him.

Two-shot profile: Teacher seated at left in a rolled-sleeve white dress shirt facing the 30-lever generator box at right; Experimenter in grey technician's coat stands beside the console leaning one arm on top of the metal cabinet and asks the Teacher to roll up his sleeve for a sample shock.

Rigged paper slip draw: Experimenter in knee-length grey technician's coat stands at left holding two slips toward the two seated volunteers in dark 1960s suits against vertical striped laboratory drapes.

Word-pair test and 150V/180V protests: 1-2-3-4 answer box lights up above the panel; Learner shouts through the wall ('Get me out of here!'); Teacher in short-sleeved white shirt hesitates with elbow on desk and hand pressed over his forehead and eyes while Experimenter delivers Prod 2 ('The experiment requires you continue, teacher. Please continue').
Layout comparison of Milgram's 1961 two-room setup (Experimenter, Teacher at 30-lever 15V-450V generator, Learner behind partition wall) and the four standardized verbal prods.
Close-up of the Teacher's bare forearm resting on the desk beside the 30 toggle switches; Experimenter squeezes white electrode paste onto the wrist and straps the metal contact plate in place.

scenes.title: Learner pounding on the dividing wall at 150V and 300V, then silence
scenes.space: Split cross-section view bisecting the dividing partition wall between the two basement rooms. On the left side of the wall, the Learner sits strapped into the wooden armchair, hammering his fist against the partition wall at 300 and 315 volts before slumping completely still. On the right side of the wall, the Teacher sits at the 30-lever generator desk, flinching as the wall vibrates.
scenes.lighting: Bright daylight across both sides of the bisected partition wall.
scenes.wardrobe: Same 1961 Yale wardrobe: rolled-sleeve white dress shirt on Teacher, grey technician coat on Experimenter, dress shirt on strapped Learner.

beats.action: pounds his clenched fist against the dividing wall twice -> strains against the leather wrist straps -> slumps motionless in the chair after 315 volts
jolts back from the desk as the wall thuds -> grips his hair with one hand -> reaches out and presses the final 450-volt XXX toggle switch down
trembles visibly, elbows braced on the wooden desk, burying his forehead in his palm before pushing the switch

scenes.recognition_hook: Fists pounding through the laboratory wall followed by eerie silence while the volunteer still flips switches to 450 volts.

scenes.title: Touch-proximity variation: forcing the learner's hand onto the metal plate
scenes.era: 1961-1962, Yale University interaction laboratory (Milgram 1965 proximity and touch-proximity series)
scenes.space: Single-room staging with the partition wall removed. The Learner sits at the same table right beside the Teacher, next to a flat wired metal plate connected to the 30-lever generator box. The grey-coated Experimenter stands beside them ordering the Teacher to press the Learner's hand down onto the plate.
scenes.lighting: Bright studio daylight revealing the immediate physical closeness of Teacher and Learner.
scenes.wardrobe: 1960s rolled-sleeve dress shirt on Teacher, dress shirt on Learner, grey lab coat on Experimenter.

scenes.title: Defiance: refusing the bare order and dissenting peers walking out
scenes.era: 1961-1962, Yale University interaction laboratory (Prod 4 analysis and Experiment 17 two-peers defiance)
scenes.space: At the 30-lever generator desk, the Teacher sits flanked by two peer teachers (or faces the Experimenter alone as Prod 4 'You have no other choice' is delivered). The peers push their chairs back and stand up to refuse, and the Teacher releases the switch lever and shoves his chair back from the console.
scenes.lighting: Bright daylight illuminating the clear physical break from authority.
scenes.wardrobe: 1960s dress shirts and ties on Teacher and peers; grey technician coat on Experimenter.

props.name: 30-lever voltage generator box
props.behaviour: partial row of levers flips back up, voltmeter needle drops to zero, red indicator light clicks off

beats.action: steps forward -> points clipboard sharply at the switches ('You have no other choice, you must go on')
slam palms flat on the desk -> shove their wooden chairs backward -> stand up and step away from the switch console
stands tall with squared shoulders and raised palm, refusing to touch another switch
lowers the clipboard to his side as the session terminates

scenes.recognition_hook: When given a bare order ('you have no other choice') or when peers say no first, people push their chairs back and refuse.
